selection_basis: Select task structure and adapter capabilities before running; do not filter by score or measured reuse.

controlled.scenario: Repeated original AppWorld api_docs request; declared catalog version invalidation
Repeated original Spotify playlist read; write/TTL/principal invalidation
Real AppWorld login, issuer-verified JWT lifetime, repeated login, cache expiry, logout and rejected old token
Original BFCL missing resource; same-operation failure reuse, condition change, pre-execution transient fault and lost write response

agent_tasks.selection_reason: File discovery, deletion and subsequent directory read; exercises read/write validity and possible business failures.
agent_tasks.limitations: No credential issuer; task structure does not guarantee a cache hit.

agent_tasks.selection_reason: Find shortest Spotify playlist duration: API discovery, login, authenticated playlist/song reads and answer validation.
agent_tasks.limitations: Natural repetitions and failures must be observed; they are not injected into the agent run.

scoring: Use original business oracles. Controlled repetitions and injected faults are coverage checks, not evidence of natural benchmark gains.
infrastructure_failures: Keep reason and partial cost; stop the affected backend rather than repeatedly chasing queue rejection.
business_failures: Retain as task failures; never replace a task because its oracle fails.
